pages.title: Ultimate TicTacToe
pages.creator: godoflaws
pages.description:
Ultimate TicTacToe expands the familiar three-in-a-row game across nine smaller boards. Place your symbol in an empty cell to send the next player to the corresponding mini board. Each turn affects both the board you are trying to win and where the next move must happen.

Claim a mini board with a line of three symbols, then claim three mini boards in a row to win the match. When the destination board is full or already won, the next player can choose any available board.

pages.title: Tap Arrow Away
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description:
Tap Arrow Away hides pixel pictures beneath a board of arrow blocks. Tap a block when it has room to leave in the direction its arrow points, and work out an order that clears the whole layout. A mistaken move costs a life.

Removing every block reveals the picture underneath. Hundreds of levels feature animals, objects, and other pixel images, with more demanding arrangements as you progress.

pages.title: Spot Differences Bird Adventure
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Spot Differences Bird Adventure challenges you to compare pairs of bird pictures and locate the details that have changed. Examine both scenes, then select the differences with a mouse or touchpad. Finish finding the changes before the level timer runs out.

pages.title: Cut In Half
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Cut In Half sends a knife along a route filled with objects to slice and hazards to avoid. Tap to make the knife spin and jump, cutting obstacles as you work toward the finish. Touching a red block or falling into a valley ends the run. Collect goods along the way to unlock additional characters.

pages.title: Sprunki Monster Music Beats
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description: Sprunki Monster Music Beats is a music mixer in which each character contributes a different sound. Combine them to create melodies ranging from calm to energetic. The cast includes Huggy Wuggy, Freddy, Among Us, and Rainbow Friends.

pages.title: Brain Test IQ Challenge 2
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Brain Test IQ Challenge 2 brings together drawing puzzles, jumping challenges, battles, and maze escapes. One drawing task asks you to make a line that guides a character to the correct restroom. Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with the different challenges.

pages.title: Tile Adventure
pages.creator: Ocean Studios, Inc.
pages.description:
Tile Adventure is a matching puzzle in which you collect tiles into a tray. Tap or click a tile to take it, then gather three identical tiles to remove that set. The tray has limited space, so avoid filling it before you can make another match.

Clear every tile to finish a level as the boards become harder. Undo and shuffle boosters can help you adjust your selections or rearrange the tiles.

pages.title: Container Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Container Sort Puzzle puts you in charge of organizing cargo at a port. Drag containers, stack them, and sort them by color and type so they can be loaded onto the appropriate ships. The arrangements grow trickier across the levels, while progression opens additional harbors.

pages.title: Save Seafood
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Save Seafood is a puzzle about freeing sea creatures from a crowded tangle. Move and rearrange the animals to separate them, working through the group until every creature is free. Use the left mouse button to select the animals as you work out how to untangle each arrangement.

pages.title: Doors Awakening
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Doors Awakening is a 3D escape puzzle centered on opening doors. Search each scene for clues and solve the puzzles that keep the exit closed. Click or slide with the mouse, or tap and slide on a touchscreen, to interact with the handcrafted levels.

pages.title: Nightmare Couple Halloween Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Nightmare Couple Halloween Party lets you dress a couple for a Halloween celebration. Choose costumes, accessories, and makeup styles to create their party looks, combining the available fashion items into outfits with a spooky theme. Use the left mouse button or tap to make your selections.

pages.title: Antistress - Simulator Of Sequins DIY
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Antistress - Simulator Of Sequins DIY lets you change a sequin picture by brushing across its surface. Select a picture, pattern, or drawing, then swipe your finger over the sequins to alter the design.

pages.title: Ultra Pixel Survive 2
pages.creator: Gold Skull Studios
pages.description:
Ultra Pixel Survive 2 combines village defense with resource gathering and action battles. Lead heroes with different abilities, collect natural resources, and turn them into materials for construction. Build and improve defenses to protect the village when enemy hordes arrive.

Hunt, cook, upgrade heroes, and unlock more characters as you develop the settlement. Underground dungeons add exploration and large boss fights. Use A and D for movement, attack with the mouse, and use the on-screen buttons to select abilities and interact with structures.

pages.title: Rescue Hero
pages.creator: Gamee JSC
pages.description:
Rescue Hero is a pin-pulling puzzle about collecting treasure and saving a princess from monsters. Choose which pins to remove and in what order so the hero can reach the treasure and complete the rescue.

Lava and poisonous gas can be sent into enemy compartments, while some puzzles require you to cut ropes to free the princess. Plan those releases around the dangers facing the hero.

pages.title: Retro Street Fighter
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Retro Street Fighter is a side-scrolling brawler with pixel art, multiple stages, and seven difficulty settings. Fight different enemies using punches and kicks, and block attacks as you work through the levels.

On a keyboard, move with the arrow keys, punch with J, kick with I, jump with K, and block with L. Touch controls provide a movement wheel and buttons for attacking and defending.

pages.title: Easter Rabbit Style
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description:
Easter Rabbit Style combines an Easter egg search with dressing forest fairies for the holiday. Search for eggs and choose themed outfits and accessories, including bags and hats with rabbit ears.

Click with the mouse or use touch to make your selections. You can save the finished result as a PNG image.

pages.title: World Of Fighters: Iron Fists
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description:
World Of Fighters: Iron Fists casts you as a member of a vigilante group taking on street gangs and a boss. Fight through the city with punches and kicks, defending yourself against the thugs.

Move with the arrow keys, punch with Z, kick with X, defend with C, and jump with Space. Combine a double tap left or right with Z or X to perform a special attack.

pages.title: Hatching Nursery Kids Virtual Pet Game
pages.creator: Amin Abdinejad
pages.description: Hatching Nursery Kids Virtual Pet Game starts with an egg containing a baby creature. Hatch it, feed the animal, and help it grow. Food comes from playing games, so caring for your creatures means earning their next meals through those activities. Use the mouse or touch controls to interact with the nursery.

pages.title: Squid Deadflip
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Squid Deadflip challenges you to send a Squid character through a somersault and land safely on the ground. Hold the left mouse button and release to control the attempt. Work through more than two dozen level designs as you try to help the character escape.

pages.title: Stickman Super Hero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Stickman Super Hero puts stick-figure heroes into battles against forces threatening Earth. Choose a fighter, improve their power, and collect stars in fights to unlock more heroes. You can also take part in a tournament.

Use the mouse to move your character and attack, or move and attack by touching the screen.

pages.title: Dress Up Game Fashion Stylist
pages.creator: LEOSTORE
pages.description: Dress Up Game Fashion Stylist lets you create a fashion-show look by choosing an outfit for a model. Use the mouse or touch controls to select clothing and put together your own style.

pages.title: Ping
pages.creator: nau.studio
pages.description: Ping is a timing game about sending a ball between two sides while keeping it clear of a wall. Tap to launch the ball, wait for it to reach the other side, and send it back. Each successful arrival adds a point, while hitting the wall ends the attempt. The game gets faster over time.

pages.title: Super Goal
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Super Goal is a soccer shooting challenge where both direction and timing matter. Aim a shot toward the target while keeping the ball clear of obstacles and opposing players. Draw the aiming line with your finger, then release to shoot and work through the levels.

pages.title: Stervella in the Fashion World
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Stervella in the Fashion World follows Estelle, an aspiring fashion designer who uses the name Stervella. Help her create bold looks by combining contrasting styles, outfits, and accessories. Use the left mouse button or touch controls to choose the pieces for her fashion designs.

pages.title: Warrior Orc
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Warrior Orc follows an orc trying to survive a monster-filled jungle and find his way back to his own world. Work through the stages, using the available double jump and getting on top of monsters to defeat them. Use the WASD keys to play through this pixel-art adventure.

pages.title: SPACE ODYSSEY
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: SPACE ODYSSEY puts you in charge of a spaceship on an endless journey through space, with Earth as your destination. Guide the ship through a course filled with rockets, asteroids, and other obstacles. Use the left and right arrow keys or A and D; the left mouse button is also supported.

pages.title: Mr Fight Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Mr Fight Online turns your fighter's body into a projectile. Throw the character into opponents on the level's platforms, using the game's physics to defeat every enemy and clear the stage. Try to improve your score on another attempt. The game also includes unlockable character skins and different gameplay modes.

pages.title: Candy Burst
pages.creator: BetaPub
pages.description:
Candy Burst challenges you to swap sweets into groups of at least three matching colors and meet each level's goal. Matches of four or more produce explosive power-ups that help with the board.

The game has hundreds of levels and missions. Earn three stars on levels to open gates to further stages, and return for daily challenges and gifts.

pages.title: Candy Burst
pages.creator: Bizogames.com
pages.description: Candy Burst is a match-three puzzle played by swiping to swap candies. Make matching sweet combinations to work through its level challenges.

pages.title: Candy Puzzle Blocks
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Candy Puzzle Blocks asks you to drag and drop candy blocks into position to create complete lines. Finished lines disappear and add to your score.

pages.title: Parkour Climb
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Parkour Climb sends you upward between walls. Tap to jump from one wall to the other and see how high you can climb. Pick up shields that stop a fall and jetpacks that increase your score.

pages.title: Superhero Dentist
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Superhero Dentist puts you in charge of a clinic for crime-fighting patients. Treat them with mouth spray, dental tweezers and braces, using the mouse or tapping to interact with the tools.

pages.title: Hatch Your Unicorn Idol
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Hatch Your Unicorn Idol combines virtual pet care with creating a pony music band. Hatch little unicorns, care for them and bring their different styles together as they sing and dance. Use the mouse or tap to play.

pages.title: Monster Truck Racing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take on computer-controlled rivals in Monster Truck Racing and try to finish in first place. Steer your truck with A and D or the left and right arrow keys. Press W or the up arrow to jump during the race.

pages.title: Sky Burger
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Sky Burger challenges you to stack a towering burger from beef, cheese, eggs, lettuce and other ingredients. Tap to play and keep adding layers as long as the stack can stand, building your burger higher.

pages.title: Princess Glitter Coloring
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Princess Glitter Coloring offers more than fifty drawing and coloring pages featuring dresses, makeup, beauty themes and accessories. Use the mouse or tap to color the pictures and work on the book's different designs.

pages.title: Kingdom Defense
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Defend your fortress against enemy attacks in Kingdom Defense. Improve your heroes and tower, and use magic and superpowers to resist the forces coming your way. Play with the mouse or tap the on-screen buttons to control the defense.

pages.title: Charge Now
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: In Charge Now, every plug needs a matching socket. Use the one-finger controls to connect them all.

pages.title: Kick The Teddy Bear
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Kick The Teddy Bear lets you attack a teddy-bear puppet with kicks and a selection of weapons. Tap to play, and buy different weapons to use against the bear.

pages.title: Water surfing Car Game
pages.creator: GameZing
pages.description: Water surfing Car Game is a car stunt simulator centered on driving across water. Use the keyboard arrow keys to control your car and work through the water-surfing levels.

pages.title: Supermarket Dash
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Supermarket Dash puts you to work across several parts of a grocery store. Help customers at the cash register and complete tasks in the grocery, cheese and salami, and fruit and vegetable departments. Click or tap to handle the different shopping jobs and provide the service each customer needs.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Tropical Slide
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Search tropical scenes for the items on your list in Hidden Objects Tropical Slide. Check the list on the left and locate every object before the timer expires. The game has 16 levels, with a hint button to help when an item proves difficult to spot. You can also zoom in with the magnifying glass and drag the enlarged scene around to examine it more closely.

pages.title: Bridal Atelier
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Bridal Atelier puts you in charge of wedding styling for princesses. Choose their bridal outfits and create the looks they will wear for the celebration.

pages.title: Basketball Star
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build and train a team for 3D basketball competitions in Basketball Star. Control your players in matches and collect shoes and shirts that improve their abilities. Progress through chapters to earn coins. Swipe and click to play.

pages.title: Cute Dolls Open Eggs
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Open surprise eggs in Cute Dolls Open Eggs to uncover collectible dolls and accessories. The surprises include outfits, jewelry and cosmetics for the dolls, with several mini-games available alongside the unwrapping. Use the mouse to open the eggs and discover which toy or accessory is hidden inside.

pages.title: Super Blocky Race
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Select a car and race amid heavy traffic in Super Blocky Race. Drive at speed and earn coins that you can spend on additional cars. Use the arrow keys to control your vehicle.

pages.title: Mothers Day 2020 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of three pictures in Mothers Day 2020 Slide, then rebuild it by swapping neighboring tiles. Click a tile and then an adjacent piece to exchange their positions until the picture is in order. The three modes use 3×3, 4×4 and 5×5 grids, giving you different numbers of pieces to arrange.

pages.title: Klara Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Study the images in Klara Memory before they disappear, then use what you remember to find them again. Each level tests how quickly you can recall their positions. The timer becomes less forgiving as you progress, and running out of time sends you back to the beginning. Use the mouse to choose images.

pages.title: Extreme Balancer 3D
pages.creator: Matrix Info Service
pages.description: Guide a ball along narrow wooden bridges in Extreme Balancer 3D. Your goal is to reach the final platform while navigating traps and keeping the ball on the raised paths. Water and ice surround the course, and falling off the bridge fails the level. Use the arrow keys to move the ball.

pages.title: Flappy Bird Game with a Twist
pages.creator: Pixellicious
pages.description: Tap to keep your bird airborne in Flappy Bird Game with a Twist, where shooting lets you clear obstacles from your flight path. Choose from four birds and try the Classic or Villain mode. Stay in flight for longer to build your score.

pages.title: Town Bus Driver
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Take a city bus through a parking challenge in Town Bus Driver. Maneuver around the lot and guide the vehicle into the correct spot while keeping it clear of anything that could scratch or dent it.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Christmas Dream
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Christmas Dream takes Hazel on a festive trip with Santa. Help them prepare by wrapping Christmas presents, then join their reindeer sleigh ride to deliver the gifts to children around town. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and the other characters during the Christmas activities.

pages.title: Mahjong Big
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Mahjong Big brings more than 4,000 levels of tile matching solitaire. Select two tiles with the same design to remove them as a pair, and work through the remaining tiles until the board is empty.

pages.title: Sanicball Downhill
pages.creator: Smartline-Games
pages.description: Sanicball Downhill is an endless ball run through a city of skyscrapers. Use the arrow keys to move across platforms, pass over boost pads to help make jumps, and avoid crates and walls.

pages.title: Bull Shooting
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Bull Shooting places you in streets overrun by wild bulls. Aim a sniper rifle at the animals and use headshots to stop the rampage. Move with WASD, hold Shift to run, and use the mouse to fire as you take on the bulls one at a time.

pages.title: Floral Manicure Decoration
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Floral Manicure Decoration lets you design a manicure with the mouse. Decorate the nails and experiment with your own nail art ideas.

pages.title: Super Sports Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Super Sports Cars Puzzle gives you six car pictures to reconstruct as jigsaws. Choose an image, then select a version with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Use the mouse to assemble the picture.

pages.title: 90 Degrees
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: 90 Degrees sends your character moving diagonally inside a confined box. Click or tap to turn its direction by 90 degrees, timing each change to dodge objects entering the screen and avoid the surrounding hazards. A collision ends the run, so keep moving safely while you try to raise your score.

pages.title: Mahjong Impossible
pages.creator: CMC Online s.r.o.
pages.description: Mahjong Impossible challenges you to remove pairs of stones from an unusually difficult arrangement. Select each pair with the mouse and plan your choices as you aim for a higher score. Removing every stone from the board is an especially demanding goal.

pages.title: Doodle Farm
pages.creator: JoyBits
pages.description: Begin with four creatures in Doodle Farm and combine them to discover new animals. Use the mouse or your finger to choose and mix a pair, then see what the combination creates. Build up an animal kingdom by working out which pairings produce new creatures, from familiar pets to wild animals.

pages.title: EG Dangerous Turn
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Dangerous Turn asks you to keep a car on the road using a single click or tap to change its direction. Time your turns so the car avoids the roadside: hitting the edge ends the attempt. The game gradually speeds up, making each turn harder to judge.

pages.title: Pigs Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a picture in Pigs Coloring Book and use the brush to add the colors you want. Select a color, paint the image, and build your own version of the drawing.

pages.title: Flicky Blade
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Flicky Blade is a physics-based knife tossing game with more than 120 blade designs and three different scenes. Use the mouse to throw a knife so it sticks into the target. A successful landing takes you to the next level, making the way the knife lands the central challenge.

pages.title: Stickman Boxing KO Champion
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Stickman Boxing KO Champion puts you in the ring against four professional fighters. Use jabs, crosses, hooks, uppercuts and body punches to attack, then dodge to avoid the reply. Combine your strikes into combos and work special punches into the fight as you try to defeat each opponent.

pages.title: Car Trials
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Car Trials gives you nine driving missions to complete. Take control of the car and follow each mission's route, working toward finishing the course.

pages.title: Bag Design Contest
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Bag Design Contest lets you create bags for a fashion event. Select the colors, patterns, and designs for your entry, then see how a jury votes on the finished bag.

pages.title: Swing Triangle
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: In Swing Triangle, touch and drag left or right to steer a triangle past obstacles. Collect stars along the course and guide the triangle to the finish to complete the stage. Hitting an obstacle restarts the stage.

pages.title: Extreme Bikers
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Extreme Bikers sends you along a bike course where jumps, stunts, and obstacles stand between you and the finish. Use the keyboard arrows to ride, working to complete the route quickly while bringing the bike safely to the end.

pages.title: Cube Jump Online
pages.creator: Plonga.com
pages.description: Cube Jump Online challenges you to guide a cube from one platform to the next. Make the jumps and gather gems as you go; those gems unlock more cube characters for you to use.

pages.title: The Haunted Mansion
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: The Haunted Mansion is a crate-pushing puzzle set in rooms threatened by zombies. Move the character around each room and push crates over holes in the rotten floor to stop the zombies from coming through. Secure the room before escaping to the next one, using touch or swipe input to move and push the crates.

pages.title: Sochi Toilets : Backstage
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Sochi Toilets : Backstage puts you in charge of a busy toilet facility in a comic management game. Seat the waiting customers, offer them toilet paper, collect their payment, and clean up after them.

Work through sixty levels as the queues grow and more customers need attention. Keep up with the arrivals while handling the different tasks involved in each visit.

pages.title: The Gun Club Shooter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: The Gun Club Shooter is a target-shooting game focused on moving targets. Use mouse or touch input to take your shots, earning money that can buy additional weapons. Work through the game's levels and challenges as you try different guns and keep up with the targets' movement.

pages.title: Jumper Frog Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Jumper Frog Game asks you to guide a frog into one of five coves at the top of the screen. Start at the bottom and make your way upward, using the arrow controls or sliding to move the frog toward a destination.

pages.title: 2018 Stylish Makeup Look
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: 2018 Stylish Makeup Look puts you in charge of Princess Ellie's makeup during a hotel spa visit. She wants to try the makeup trends of 2018, and your task is to create her look while she spends the weekend relaxing.

pages.title: Sisters Halloween Preparations
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Sisters Halloween Preparations is a dress-up and face-art game about getting two sisters ready for Halloween. Create their scary face-art masks, then choose outfits to go with the designs and finish their Halloween looks.

pages.title: Bonbon Monsters
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Bonbon Monsters is a feeding puzzle built around monsters with different abilities. Help the blue monsters reach their food with their long arms, using the other monsters when the food is out of reach. Violet monsters push food and objects away, while red monsters flip food, monsters, and stones. Combine these actions to get a meal to the blue monsters.
